item.text:
Subject: Returning Your Camera

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for lending me your camera. I really enjoyed using it, especially during my walk along the coast last weekend. My favorite photograph is one I took at sunset, when the sky turned bright orange and the waves reflected the light—it came out beautifully!

I’d like to return the camera soon. I can bring it to your place on Thursday evening, or we could meet at the café near the station if that’s more convenient. I’m free anytime after 6 p.m., but please let me know what works best for you.

Thanks again for trusting me with it. I’ve really enjoyed trying it out!

Best,  
Sam
